_readme: Override the meta title, meta description, canonical (permalink), robots or social image of ANY page without touching code. Key = page path ('/' for the home page, no trailing slash). All fields are optional: title, description, canonical (path or full URL), noindex (true/false), ogImage, ogImageAlt. Titles: aim for 60 characters or fewer. Descriptions: 120 to 160 characters. After editing run: npm run build && node scripts/validate-seo.mjs
